gloss: wording (of a letter or message); text

definitions.gloss: wording; text (of a letter or message)
definitions.explanation: What a letter, email or other written message says, and the way it is worded, especially as a clue to the writer's feelings or intent.

examples.japanese: ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文面|ぶんめん}。
{文面|ぶんめん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{怒|おこ}っている→怒る：00876_okoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: You can tell from the wording that he's angry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{文面|ぶんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}した→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: Before sending it to my boss, I went over the wording again and again to make sure it wasn't rude.

notes:
⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧ (writing) + ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧ (face, surface). Refers to the message as written, often in contrast to what the writer really meant or what is read between the lines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文面|ぶんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧: to work out the wording
- {文面|ぶんめん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{察|さっ}する→察する：08053_sassuru⟧: to infer from the wording
- ⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧な{文面|ぶんめん}: politely worded text

SIMILAR WORDS:
